properties.description: Monster Energy is a global leader in the energy drink category, recognized for its aggressive branding and association with extreme sports and gaming culture. Founded in 2002, the company has expanded beyond traditional energy drinks to include coffee, tea, and juice-based energy formulations. It effectively targets an active, young-adult demographic that values high performance and a non-conformist lifestyle. The brand is built on the core philosophy of 'Unleashing the Beast,' maintaining high visibility through massive partnerships in professional sports, esports, and musical events worldwide.
properties.short_description: Monster Energy is a brand known for its energy drinks, coffee, tea, and juice products, promoting an active lifestyle with the slogan 'Unleash the Beast'.

short_descriptions.value: A high-octane beverage brand fueling extreme athletes, gamers, and thrill-seekers with bold, energy-boosting drinks that embody an aggressive and rebellious spirit.

Eine energiereiche Getränkemarke, die Athleten, Gamer und Abenteurer mit kraftvollen Rezepturen und einem kompromisslosen, rebellischen Lebensgefühl unterstützt.

properties.description: Monster Energy Yamaha MotoGP is the official factory racing team of Yamaha, competing at the pinnacle of the MotoGP World Championship. Founded in 1999 as Yamaha Factory Racing, the team is based in Gerno di Lesmo, Italy, where it manages technical, logistical, and communication operations. With a deep history of championship excellence, the team focuses on continuous innovation and the development of high-performance racing prototypes. It serves as a global ambassador for the manufacturer, attracting motorsports enthusiasts and performance-focused fans worldwide.
properties.short_description: Monster Energy Yamaha MotoGP is Yamaha's official factory team competing in the MotoGP World Championship, featuring riders like Fabio Quartararo and Álex Rins.

properties.description: Rockstar Energy Drink is a prominent energy beverage brand founded in 2001 that specializes in products designed to sustain mental and physical energy. The brand offers a wide variety of formulas, including zero-sugar options, recovery drinks with electrolytes, and flavor-focused lines to suit diverse activity levels and preferences. It maintains a strong market position as an accessible, high-energy companion for gamers, athletes, and individuals with demanding lifestyles. Currently owned by PepsiCo, the brand continues to emphasize its bold identity through extensive presence in extreme sports and mainstream retail channels.
properties.short_description: Rockstar Energy Drink is a brand of energy drinks offering various flavors to sustain mind and body energy.

short_descriptions.value: Eine Marke für Energy-Drinks, die die mentale und körperliche Ausdauer liefert, die für ein Leben mit maximalem Einsatz erforderlich ist.
Une marque de boissons énergisantes conçue pour offrir l'endurance mentale et physique nécessaire à ceux qui vivent à cent à l'heure.
A high-energy beverage brand designed to provide the mental and physical stamina needed for those who live life at full volume.

properties.description: Monster Jam is a global live entertainment tour featuring competitive monster truck racing and freestyle stunt exhibitions. Owned by Feld Entertainment, it focuses on family-centric spectacles held in large stadiums and arenas worldwide. The brand is recognized for its theatrical production, iconic truck designs, and the intensity of its high-speed motorized competitions. It holds a unique position as a major fixture in sports entertainment, catering to multi-generational audiences.
properties.short_description: Monster Jam is a live motorsports event featuring monster truck racing and freestyle competitions, known for thrilling stunts and family entertainment.

short_descriptions.value: Une expérience de sport automobile à haute intensité mettant en scène des camions monstres réalisant des cascades spectaculaires et des courses dans des stades du monde entier.
A high-octane motorsports experience featuring massive monster trucks performing gravity-defying stunts and competitive racing in stadiums worldwide.
Una experiencia automovilística de alta intensidad con camiones monstruo que realizan acrobacias asombrosas y competiciones en estadios de todo el mundo.
Ein hochoktaniges Motorsport-Erlebnis mit gigantischen Monstertrucks, die atemberaubende Stunts und Wettbewerbe in Stadien weltweit präsentieren.

properties.description: Red Bull is a world-renowned energy drink brand recognized for its unique identity in high-performance and extreme-sports culture. Established in 1987, the company produces a variety of energy drinks and is deeply integrated into global media and event sponsorship. The brand positions itself as a catalyst for mental and physical alertness, appealing to a broad demographic of active, performance-driven consumers. Through its extensive involvement in motorsports, music, and gaming, it maintains a strong cultural relevance as a leader in the energy beverage industry.
properties.short_description: Red Bull is a global brand known for its energy drinks, including original, sugar-free, zero-calorie, and flavored editions, and its involvement in sports and entertainment events.

short_descriptions.value: Une marque mondiale de boissons énergisantes qui stimule les performances physiques et mentales grâce au parrainage de sports extrêmes et d'événements culturels dynamiques.
